values.meaning: Duration of the enraged state (AD/resist buff, cc-immunity)
Duration extension per basic attack on-hit or Reckless Swing cast against a champion
values.quote: increased by and up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds for each basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or cast of ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}

mechanics.claim: The bonus attack damage recalculates continuously over the duration, so later AD changes still get amplified by the 25% ratio.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} updates dynamically over the duration; Increases or reductions in {{as|attack damage}} after the effect has been applied will still be amplified.

mechanics.claim: The 25% AD ratio also amplifies the flat AD bonus, not just Olaf's base/bonus AD.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|25% attack damage}} scaling amplifies the flat {{as|attack damage '''bonus'''}} as well.

mechanics.claim: Ragnarok will not expire mid-cast of Reckless Swing, extending effective uptime of the AD buff during a Reckless Swing cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Ragnarok'' will not expire during {{ais|Reckless Swing|Olaf}} cast time.

mechanics.claim: The duration extension only occurs against enemy champions, not against monsters/minions.
mechanics.quote: increased by and up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds for each basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or cast of ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}

mechanics.claim: Cleansing and cc-immunity are defensive, not offensive, effects.
mechanics.quote: cleansing himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to them}}

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on the end of the effect duration.
